title: Add a QQ16 ordinary-source tap witness repair
body:
## Result

This adds a concrete QQ16 local interface mechanism: keep PR #2216's sum-preserving `X_T += X_A; Y_T -= X_A` shear and add a paired tap from the already-live ordinary source port 2 into selected pair 21:

```text
X_21 += X_2
Y_21 -= X_2
```

On the exact PR #2093 three-port hidden `h` witness, this tap preserves `X_21 + Y_21` and produces final bank 0, component X, port 21 equal to `11 f_37` through the complete retained tail. The exact receipt has 34 selected outputs, 4 forward-history rows, and 65 completed-X rows.

## Evidence and cost

The package pins the base, selected record, source maps, and copied predecessor verifiers. It reproduces the full-tail result, the no-tap and off-support-source controls, and a wrong-sign control. All 24 supported one-source/one-T-pair candidates were screened at B1; the first positive, `U2 -> T21`, was then run through the full tail. The retained PR #2216 eight-direction rank-eight witness is independently rechecked at B1, with exact minor determinant `-1/4096`.

The added tap costs 2 scalar additions per owner, no helper, no recursive child, and no frame transition. Its coefficients are `+1` and `-1`; a conservative local triangle bound charges one additional magnitude bit on the changed envelopes.

## Scope and limits

This is one exact kernel-witness repair through a fixed retained QQ16 schedule. It does not establish full controller injectivity, a global precision/all-size contract, supplier admission, or a new κ. The eight PR #2216 directions have not been replayed through the tail with this tap. Full ordered-kernel integration and owner placement remain open.

PR #2216 remains open. This package changes the ordinary source-to-selected interface and carries PR #2093's `h` witness through the complete tail; it complements the A-to-T shear and its eight-direction B1 result. PR #2079's bounded B2 observation is related context, with a different source observation.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/qq16-ordinary-source-tap-seed3794b3/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-ordinary-source-tap-seed3794b3 --check-only
```

Local exact replay and package checks passed under Python 3.14.7. The registered package runner targets Python 3.12; hosted CI will provide that runtime check.

Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. Selected-record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used in the construction, integration, and exact replay; no independent human review is claimed. Source attribution is included in the package.
